g.text: M7: absolute and normalized decay; input amplitudes are preserved
Limited inlet band with SVV; scope-qualified descriptive comparison. No full-band fidelity or 2% accuracy verdict.
Normalization is for display only. Table-4 K uses 3 u_rms^2 / 2; simulated K uses all three temporal variances. No experimental error bar is assumed.
